北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天，体感 6℃，风吹有些凉，记得添衣哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Beijing, feels like 6℃. A bit chilly with wind, remember to layer up!
北京.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天湿润，体感 11℃。注意保暖，别着凉了呀。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy and humid in Cixi, feels like 11℃. Keep warm, don't catch a cold.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，体感 10℃ 略湿，出门别忘带把伞哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Shanghai, feels like 10℃ and damp. Don't forget an umbrella!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阳光正好 22℃，体感舒适，记得多喝水哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Sunny and pleasant 22℃ in Guangzhou. Remember to stay hydrated!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴朗 19℃，体感宜人，心情也要美美哒！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Sunny 19℃ in Shenzhen, feels lovely. Enjoy your day!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天，体感 10℃。早晚温差大，注意加衣哦。
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Hangzhou, feels like 10℃. Mind the temperature change, wear more!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，湿度 100%。体感 7℃，感觉湿冷，多穿点。
南京.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Nanjing, 100% humidity, feels like 7℃. It's damp and cold, dress warmly!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天，体感 8℃。注意保暖，暖暖和和过一天。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Chengdu, feels like 8℃. Keep warm and cozy throughout the day.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉小雨 8℃，体感只有 3℃，湿冷加剧，注意保暖防寒。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Light rain in Wuhan, 8℃ but feels like 3℃. Damp and cold, keep very warm!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，体感 5℃。空气干燥，记得多喝水哦。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Xi'an, feels like 5℃. Air is dry, remember to hydrate!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆大雾 10℃，体感 8℃。能见度低，出行多注意安全。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Foggy 10℃ in Chongqing, feels like 8℃. Low visibility, please be careful when out.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，体感 -5℃。注意防寒保暖，可别冻着了！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Harbin, feels like -5℃. Keep warm, don't get frostbitten!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳有霾，体感 -4℃。注意防护，出门戴好口罩哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Hazy in Shenyang, feels like -4℃. Protect yourself, wear a mask when out.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感 7℃。风力有点大，小心别着凉。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Kunming, feels like 7℃. It's windy, be careful not to catch a cold.
昆明.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门晴天，体感 11℃ 略湿，微风不燥，感觉很舒服。
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Sunny in Xiamen, feels like 11℃ and a bit humid. Gentle breeze, very pleasant.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感 5℃。风微凉，记得多穿一件衣服。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Qingdao, feels like 5℃. A cool breeze, remember to wear an extra layer.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感 0℃。虽然无风，仍需注意保暖哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Cloudy in Dalian, feels like 0℃. No wind, but still keep warm!
